column12: Number under probation per 100,000 adult U.S. residents, December 31, 2021/b

column1: Note: Due to nonresponse or incomplete data, the probation population for some jurisdictions on December 31, 2021 does not equal the population on January 1, 2021 plus entries, minus exits. Counts may not be actual as reporting agencies may provide estimates on some or all detailed data.
a/Imputed counts differ from reported counts in jurisdictions where data were not available. Details may not sum to totals due to rounding.

b/Rates are based on probation counts as of December 31 of the reporting year and calculated using U.S. Census Bureau estimates of U.S. residents age 18 or older for January 1 of the following year in each jurisdiction.
c/January 1 and December 31 probation counts are estimates of individuals.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Annual Probation Survey, 2021; and U.S. Census Bureau, National Intercensal Estimates, 2022.
